uid = me["data"]["userId"]
st, pl = call("GET", f"/api/read-user/{uid}", token=admin, expect=200)
print("read-user:", pl["data"]["username"])

# --- network ---
st, pl = call("POST", "/api/create-location", {"name": "CP-A", "coordinate": {"latitude": 12.97, "longitude": 77.59}, "coverageKm": 5, "handlingMinutes": 10, "active": True, "functions": ["collection_point", "transfer_point"]}, admin, 201)
cpA = pl["data"]["locationId"]
st, pl = call("POST", "/api/create-location", {"name": "HUB-A", "coordinate": {"latitude": 12.99, "longitude": 77.61}, "coverageKm": 5, "handlingMinutes": 10, "active": True, "functions": ["hub", "transfer_point"]}, admin, 201)
hubA = pl["data"]["locationId"]
st, pl = call("POST", "/api/create-location", {"name": "LAB-A", "coordinate": {"latitude": 13.02, "longitude": 77.60}, "coverageKm": 5, "handlingMinutes": 10, "active": True, "functions": ["laboratory"]}, admin, 201)
labA = pl["data"]["locationId"]

st, pl = call("POST", "/api/create-connection", {"fromLocationId": cpA, "toLocationId": hubA, "travelMinutes": 20, "costUnits": 1, "cooled": True, "active": True}, admin, 201)
conn1 = pl["data"]["connectionId"]
st, pl = call("POST", "/api/create-connection", {"fromLocationId": hubA, "toLocationId": labA, "travelMinutes": 20, "costUnits": 1, "cooled": True, "active": True}, admin, 201)
conn2 = pl["data"]["connectionId"]

for lid in (cpA, hubA, labA, conn1, conn2):
    call("POST", "/api/configure-capacity", {"resourceId": lid, "capacityUnits": 50, "cooledCapacityUnits": 20}, admin, 200)

st, stype = call("POST", "/api/create-sample-type", {
    "name": "S2Amber", "qualifiedCollectorRequired": True, "requiredQualification": "phlebotomy-amber",
    "containerType": "standard", "temperatureMinC": 2, "temperatureMaxC": 25,
    "incompatibleSampleTypes": [], "requiresCooledRoute": False, "batchingAllowed": True}, admin, 201)
stid = stype["data"]["sampleTypeId"]
call("POST", "/api/configure-laboratory-acceptance", {"laboratoryId": labA, "sampleTypeId": stid, "accepts": True}, admin, 200)

st, pl = call("POST", "/api/create-user", {"username": "rq2", "initialPassword": "pass1234", "roles": ["requester"], "active": True}, admin, 201)
rq2 = pl["data"]["userId"]
st, pl = call("POST", "/api/create-user", {"username": "cpw2", "initialPassword": "pass1234", "roles": ["collection_professional"], "qualifications": ["phlebotomy-amber"], "certifications": [{"code": "phlebotomy-amber", "active": True}], "active": True}, admin, 201)
cpw2 = pl["data"]["userId"]
st, pl = call("POST", "/api/create-user", {"username": "cr2", "initialPassword": "pass1234", "roles": ["delivery_partner"], "active": True}, admin, 201)
cr2 = pl["data"]["userId"]
st, pl = call("POST", "/api/create-user", {"username": "lab2", "initialPassword": "pass1234", "roles": ["laboratory_team"], "assignedLocationId": labA, "active": True}, admin, 201)
lab2 = pl["data"]["userId"]
st, pl = call("POST", "/api/create-user", {"username": "nh2", "initialPassword": "pass1234", "roles": ["node_handler"], "assignedLocationId": hubA, "active": True}, admin, 201)

rqT = login("rq2", "pass1234")
cpT = login("cpw2", "pass1234")
crT = login("cr2", "pass1234")
labT = login("lab2", "pass1234")
nhT = login("nh2", "pass1234")

st, pl = call("POST", "/api/update-user-access", {"userId": rq2, "roles": ["requester", "dispatcher"], "active": True}, admin, 201)
print("update-user-access:", pl["data"].get("roles"))
st, pl = call("POST", "/api/update-location", {"locationId": cpA, "name": "CP-A2", "coordinate": {"latitude": 12.97, "longitude": 77.59}}, admin, 201)
st, pl = call("POST", "/api/update-sample-type", {"sampleTypeId": stid, "containerType": "standard", "temperatureMinC": 2, "temperatureMaxC": 25}, admin, 201)
print("update-location/sample-type OK")
st, pl = call("POST", "/api/set-worker-availability", {"workerId": cr2, "available": True, "capacityUnits": 4}, crT, 200)
print("worker availability:", pl["data"])

def mk_request():
    st, pl = call("POST", "/api/create-collection-request", {
        "requesterId": rq2, "originType": "home",
        "origin": {"latitude": 12.971, "longitude": 77.591},
        "sampleTypeId": stid, "containerType": "standard",
        "temperatureMinC": 2, "temperatureMaxC": 25,
        "requestedAt": "2026-09-20T17:00:00Z",
        "earliestCollectionAt": "2026-09-20T17:00:00Z", "latestCollectionAt": "2026-09-20T21:00:00Z",
        "deliveryDeadline": "2026-09-21T04:00:00Z", "idempotencyKey": ik()}, rqT, 201)
    return pl["data"]

# --- decline flow ---
d1 = mk_request()
st, pl = call("POST", "/api/list-role-work", {"role": "collection_professional", "includeCompleted": False}, cpT, 200)
asg = next(i for i in work_items(pl) if i.get("sampleId") == d1["sampleId"])["assignmentId"]
st, pl = call("POST", "/api/decline-assignment", {"assignmentId": asg, "reason": "busy", "idempotencyKey": ik()}, cpT, 201)
print("decline OK:", pl["data"].get("status"))
st, pl = call("POST", "/api/list-role-work", {"role": "collection_professional", "includeCompleted": False}, cpT, 200)
items = [i for i in work_items(pl) if i.get("sampleId") == d1["sampleId"]]
print("re-offered after decline:", len(items) > 0)

# --- cancel journey ---
st, pl = call("POST", "/api/read-journey-plan", {"journeyId": d1["journeyId"]}, admin, 200)
pv1 = pl["data"].get("planVersion", 1)
st, pl = call("POST", "/api/cancel-journey", {"journeyId": d1["journeyId"], "expectedPlanVersion": pv1, "reason": "test cancel", "idempotencyKey": ik()}, admin, 201)
print("cancel-journey:", pl["data"].get("status"))

# --- presealed ingestion ---
st, pl = call("POST", "/api/ingest-presealed-sample", {
    "originType": "node", "originNodeId": cpA, "origin": {"latitude": 12.97, "longitude": 77.59},
    "sampleTypeId": stid, "containerType": "standard",
    "temperatureMinC": 2, "temperatureMaxC": 25,
    "requestedAt": "2026-09-20T17:00:00Z",
    "earliestCollectionAt": "2026-09-20T17:00:00Z", "latestCollectionAt": "2026-09-20T21:00:00Z",
    "deliveryDeadline": "2026-09-21T04:00:00Z", "idempotencyKey": ik()}, cpT, 201)
pre = pl["data"]
print("presealed:", pre.get("sampleId"), pre.get("journeyId"))

# --- full flow for d2 ---
d2 = mk_request()
st, pl = call("POST", "/api/list-role-work", {"role": "collection_professional", "includeCompleted": False}, cpT, 200)
asg = next(i for i in work_items(pl) if i.get("sampleId") == d2["sampleId"])["assignmentId"]
call("POST", "/api/accept-assignment", {"assignmentId": asg, "idempotencyKey": ik()}, cpT, 201)
st, pl = call("POST", "/api/collect-and-seal-sample", {"assignmentId": asg, "sampleId": d2["sampleId"], "containerType": "standard", "observedTemperatureC": 5, "collectedAt": "2026-09-20T17:30:00Z", "idempotencyKey": ik()}, cpT, 201)
print("sealed:", pl["data"].get("status"))

st, pl = call("POST", "/api/list-role-work", {"role": "delivery_partner", "includeCompleted": False}, crT, 200)
leg = next(i for i in work_items(pl) if i.get("sampleId") == d2["sampleId"])
legAsg = leg["assignmentId"]
call("POST", "/api/accept-assignment", {"assignmentId": legAsg, "idempotencyKey": ik()}, crT, 201)

st, pl = call("POST", "/api/initiate-handoff", {"sampleId": d2["sampleId"], "fromAssignmentId": asg, "toAssignmentId": legAsg, "receiverId": cr2, "initiatedAt": "2026-09-20T17:45:00Z", "idempotencyKey": ik()}, cpT, 201)
ho = pl["data"]["handoffId"]
call("POST", "/api/confirm-handoff", {"handoffId": ho, "confirmationSide": "sender", "confirmedAt": "2026-09-20T17:46:00Z", "idempotencyKey": ik()}, cpT, 201)
st, pl = call("POST", "/api/confirm-handoff", {"handoffId": ho, "confirmationSide": "receiver", "confirmedAt": "2026-09-20T17:47:00Z", "idempotencyKey": ik()}, crT, 201)
print("handoff cp->courier:", pl["data"].get("status"))

# courier -> node handler at hub
st, pl = call("POST", "/api/list-role-work", {"role": "node_handler", "includeCompleted": False}, nhT, 200)
nodeItems = [i for i in work_items(pl) if i.get("sampleId") == d2["sampleId"]]
print("node handler items:", len(nodeItems))
if nodeItems:
    nAsg = nodeItems[0]["assignmentId"]
    call("POST", "/api/accept-assignment", {"assignmentId": nAsg, "idempotencyKey": ik()}, nhT, 201)
    st, pl = call("POST", "/api/initiate-handoff", {"sampleId": d2["sampleId"], "fromAssignmentId": legAsg, "toAssignmentId": nAsg, "receiverId": nh2, "initiatedAt": "2026-09-20T18:30:00Z", "idempotencyKey": ik()}, crT, 201)
    ho2 = pl["data"]["handoffId"]
    call("POST", "/api/confirm-handoff", {"handoffId": ho2, "confirmationSide": "sender", "confirmedAt": "2026-09-20T18:31:00Z", "idempotencyKey": ik()}, crT, 201)

st, pl = call("POST", "/api/report-disruption", {"resourceType": "connection", "resourceId": conn2, "reason": "road closed", "occurredAt": "2026-09-20T18:40:00Z", "idempotencyKey": ik()}, admin, 201)

print("set-connection-status OK")

st, pl = call("POST", "/api/read-journey-plan", {"journeyId": d2["journeyId"]}, admin, 200)
plan = pl["data"]
print("plan version:", plan.get("planVersion"), "legs:", len(plan.get("legs", [])))

print("reroute:", st, json.dumps(pl)[:250])

print("edit-active-plan:", st, json.dumps(pl)[:250])

call("POST", "/api/set-location-function-status", {"locationId": cpA, "function": "collection_point", "active": False}, admin, 200)
call("POST", "/api/set-location-function-status", {"locationId": cpA, "function": "collection_point", "active": True}, admin, 200)
call("POST", "/api/set-location-status", {"locationId": cpA, "active": False}, admin, 200)
call("POST", "/api/set-location-status", {"locationId": cpA, "active": True}, admin, 200)
print("location status toggles OK")

# --- split / merge ---
st, pl = call("POST", "/api/split-journey", {"journeyId": d2["journeyId"], "expectedPlanVersion": plan.get("planVersion"), "sampleIds": [d2["sampleId"]], "idempotencyKey": ik()}, admin)
print("split-journey:", st, json.dumps(pl)[:250])
d3 = mk_request()
st, pl = call("POST", "/api/read-journey-plan", {"journeyId": d3["journeyId"]}, admin, 200)
pv3 = pl["data"].get("planVersion", 1)
st, pl = call("POST", "/api/merge-journeys", {"targetJourneyId": d3["journeyId"], "expectedPlanVersion": pv3, "sourceJourneyIds": [pre["journeyId"]], "idempotencyKey": ik()}, admin)
print("merge-journeys:", st, json.dumps(pl)[:250])

# --- lab exception ---
st, pl = call("POST", "/api/record-laboratory-exception", {"sampleId": d2["sampleId"], "laboratoryId": labA, "reason": "damaged container", "observedAt": "2026-09-20T19:00:00Z", "idempotencyKey": ik()}, labT)
print("record-laboratory-exception:", st, json.dumps(pl)[:250])

st, pl = call("GET", "/api/events?since=0", token=admin, expect=200)
print("events:", len(pl["data"]["events"]))

print("SMOKE2 DONE")

    return pl["data"].get("status")

    st, pl = call("POST", "/api/list-role-work", {"role": "delivery_partner", "includeCompleted": False}, crT, 200)

    la = leg["assignmentId"]
    call("POST", "/api/accept-assignment", {"assignmentId": la, "idempotencyKey": ik()}, crT, 201)
    do_handoff(crT if fromAsg == legAsg else nhCur[1], crT, fromAsg, la, cr2, tbase)

        call("POST", "/api/update-assignment-progress", {"assignmentId": la, "status": s, "occurredAt": tbase, "idempotencyKey": ik()}, crT, 201)
    return la

def node_step(tok, uid, fromAsg, tbase):

    na = it["assignmentId"]
    call("POST", "/api/accept-assignment", {"assignmentId": na, "idempotencyKey": ik()}, tok, 201)

    for s in ("in_progress", "completed"):
        call("POST", "/api/update-assignment-progress", {"assignmentId": na, "status": s, "occurredAt": tbase, "idempotencyKey": ik()}, tok, 201)
    return na

def call(method, path, body=None, token=None, expect=None):
    data = json.dumps(body).encode() if body is not None else None

    if token: req.add_header("Authorization", "Bearer " + token)

    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:

    req.add_header("Content-Type", "application/json")

# Lab Sample Pickup & Delivery System

Full-stack application for managing clinical sample collection, transport, and
laboratory receipt: serviceability checks, collection requests, journeys and
assignments, capacity reservations, chain of custody, disruptions/replanning,
live tracking, and audit.

- **Backend:** Go (stdlib HTTP server), single binary at `server/lablogistics-server`
- **Frontend:** React + TypeScript (Vite), MapLibre GL JS with local PMTiles map assets
- **Datastore:** PostgreSQL only (all durable state; survives restarts)

## Build

```bash
bash app-setup/build.sh
```

Compiles the Go backend and builds the React frontend into `web/dist`.

## Run

```bash
ADMIN_USERNAME=admin ADMIN_PASSWORD=admin123 bash app-setup/start.sh
```
